elements.requirement: A regulator issuing a statement of policy under section 192H is referred to as the issuing regulator.
elements.quote: a regulator (“the issuing regulator”)

elements.requirement: Before issuing a statement of policy under section 192H, the issuing regulator must consult the other regulator.
elements.quote: consult the other regulator

elements.requirement: Before issuing a statement of policy under section 192H, where the issuing regulator is the FCA, it must consult the Bank of England.
elements.quote: where the issuing regulator is the FCA, the Bank of England

elements.requirement: Before issuing a statement of policy under section 192H, the issuing regulator must publish a draft of the proposed statement in the way appearing to it to be best calculated to bring it to the attention of the public.
elements.quote: publish a draft of the proposed statement in the way appearing to the issuing regulator to be best calculated to bring it to the attention of the public

elements.requirement: The published draft of the proposed statement must be accompanied by notice that representations about the proposal may be made to the issuing regulator within a specified time.
elements.quote: The draft must be accompanied by notice that representations about the proposal may be made to the issuing regulator within a specified time.

elements.requirement: Before issuing the proposed statement, the issuing regulator must have regard to any representations made to it in accordance with subsection (2).
elements.quote: Before issuing the proposed statement, the issuing regulator must have regard to any representations made to it in accordance with subsection (2).

elements.requirement: If the issuing regulator issues the proposed statement, it must publish an account, in general terms, of the representations made to it in accordance with subsection (2).
elements.quote: publish an account, in general terms, of— (a) the representations made to it in accordance with subsection (2)

elements.requirement: If the issuing regulator issues the proposed statement, it must publish an account, in general terms, of its response to the representations made to it in accordance with subsection (2).
elements.quote: publish an account, in general terms, of— (a) the representations made to it in accordance with subsection (2), and (b) its response to them.

elements.requirement: If the proposed statement differs from the published draft in a way which is, in the issuing regulator's opinion, significant, the issuing regulator must consult the other regulator again before issuing it.
elements.quote: must before issuing it consult the other regulator again

elements.requirement: If the proposed statement differs from the published draft in a way which is, in the issuing regulator's opinion, significant, the issuing regulator must, in addition to complying with subsection (4), publish details of the difference.
elements.quote: must (in addition to complying with subsection (4)), publish details of the difference.

elements.requirement: The issuing regulator may charge a reasonable fee for providing a person with a draft published under subsection (1)(b).
elements.quote: The issuing regulator may charge a reasonable fee for providing a person with a draft published under subsection (1)(b).

elements.requirement: The provisions of section 192I apply to a proposal to alter or replace a statement.
elements.quote: This section also applies to a proposal to alter or replace a statement.
